'od 'bar tshogs la 'di sbyar bas 'thus/hrīḥmakha' 'gro'i dbang phyug padma 'od 'bar sku/ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor tshogs sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /zhal zas tshog

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'od 'bar tshogs la 'di sbyar bas 'thus/ 1$0000290hrīḥ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug padma 'od 'bar sku /ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor tshogs sprin ltar 'khrigs// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sun ma zlogs// zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs 'bum gyis bskor// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sun= rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal// rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sun= dbang gi las mdzad padma thod phreng rtsal// padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gro'i sun= drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs bcas kyis// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sun= rig 'dzin dpa' bo yongs rje padma 'byung*// ging chen dpa' bo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= rig 'dzin dpa' bo yongs kyi sun= ma mo yongs kyi ded dpon padma 'byung*// snang srid ma mo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= snang srid ma mo rnams kyi sun= brtan ma yongs kyi spyi rje padma 'byung*// brtan skyong sman phran mang po'i g.yog dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams kyi sun= snang srid dregs pa kun 'dul padma 'byung*// sde dpon sde brgyad yul lha'i bran dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di= snang srid sde brgyad rnams kyi sun= che mchog padma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// tshe dang srog gi bar chad da zlogs shig /rnal 'byor bdag dang bsrung bya 'khor bcas kyis// o rgyan tshe dpag med la skyabs gsol gyis// thugs rje ma chung sngon gyi dam bca' dgongs// dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams zlog nas kyang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang*// byang chub sgrub la bar chad med par mdzod// bdag dang bsrung bya rdo rje'i dam tshig can// lus rten 'di la sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur med par dam bca' 'o// ye shes las dang 'jig rten sar gnas pa'i// ma mo mkha' 'gro lha srin thams cad kyang*// bdag gi byang chub sgrub la gegs ma byed// gal te byang chub sgrub la gegs byed na// lcang lo can du khro bo'i chad pas sdigs// dam tshig nyams pas rdo rje dmyal bar ltung*// de bas dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen sol la// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar mdzod// oṃ dhā ki nī sa ra nan mu kha sa du na zlog
ces o rgyan rig 'dzin gyis bskul nas a rā gas 'phral du bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
